meta.source: Graphisoft GDL Reference Guide (AC29) + Archicad 用户指南

note.zh: 术语以官方英文为准，中文采用业界通行译法。同一概念在不同中文资料里叫法不一，这里只收最容易混淆的那批，并给出英文原名便于对照官方手册。
note.en: English terms follow the official documentation; Chinese uses the common industry translation. Only genuinely confusable terms are listed, with the official English name kept for cross-checking.

desc.zh: Archicad 图库里的一个可放置对象，可以是门、窗、家具，也可以是一个纯 2D 符号。图库部件由脚本生成，不是建模出来的网格。
desc.en: A placeable object in an Archicad library — a door, a window, a piece of furniture, or a pure 2D symbol. It is generated by scripts, not modelled as a mesh.

desc.zh: 编译后的图库部件二进制文件，由 LP_XMLConverter 从 XML / 脚本目录打包生成。放到图库文件夹里，Archicad 就能加载。
desc.en: The compiled binary of a library part, produced by LP_XMLConverter from an XML or script directory. Drop it into a loaded library folder and Archicad picks it up.

desc.zh: Archicad 自带的脚本语言，用命令描述三维形体、二维符号、参数和界面。它不是通用编程语言，没有文件系统与网络能力。
desc.en: Archicad's built-in scripting language that describes 3D shapes, 2D symbols, parameters and dialogs. It is not a general-purpose language — no filesystem or network access.

desc.zh: 每个图库部件都有一段主脚本，负责向其他脚本传参、做前置计算。它先于 2D/3D 脚本执行，常放公共变量。
desc.en: Every library part has a master script that passes parameters to the other scripts and does upfront calculation. It runs before the 2D/3D scripts and usually holds shared variables.

desc.zh: 图库部件在 Archicad 里的身份：Object、Door、Window、Label 等。子类型决定它能放在哪里、能用哪些宿主参数，选错就放不进墙。
desc.en: The identity of a library part inside Archicad: Object, Door, Window, Label and so on. The subtype decides where it can be placed and which host parameters exist.

desc.zh: 被其他脚本调用的图库部件，用 CALL / MACRO 按名称加载，可传参。把重复构件做成宏，是控制对象体积的主要手段。
desc.en: A library part invoked by another script through CALL / MACRO with name and parameters. Turning repeated parts into macros is the main way to keep an object small.

desc.zh: 存放图库部件的一组文件夹或一个图库容器（.lcf）。项目只认识已加载图库里的部件，改名或换路径会导致图库部件丢失。
desc.en: A set of folders or a library container (.lcf) holding library parts. A project only sees parts in loaded libraries; renaming or moving them breaks placement.

desc.zh: 对象在平面图上的显示叫符号，坐标原点就是插入点。所有 2D 图元都相对原点绘制，原点偏移会让对象「跑偏」。
desc.en: The plan representation of an object is its symbol; the local origin is the insertion point. Every 2D primitive is drawn relative to it, so a shifted origin makes the object sit wrong.

desc.zh: 生成平面图符号的脚本，用 LINE2、ARC2、POLY2 等二维命令。不写 2D 脚本，对象在平面图上就是空的。
desc.en: The script that produces the plan symbol with 2D commands such as LINE2, ARC2 and POLY2. Without it the object shows nothing in plan.

desc.zh: 生成三维形体的脚本，用 BLOCK、PRISM、REVOLVE 等命令，配合变换堆栈定位。3D 脚本与 2D 脚本互相独立。
desc.en: The script that builds the 3D geometry with commands like BLOCK, PRISM and REVOLVE, positioned through the transformation stack. It is independent of the 2D script.

desc.zh: 在参数值变化时运行的脚本，用来做联动、校验和填值列表（VALUES）。它不画任何图形。
desc.en: A script that runs when parameter values change, used for dependencies, validation and filling value lists (VALUES). It draws nothing.

desc.zh: 描述对象设置对话框的脚本：分页、输入框、单选按钮的位置都写在这里。界面脚本不支持 3D/2D 绘图命令。
desc.en: The script describing the object settings dialog: pages, input fields and radio buttons. It does not accept 3D/2D drawing commands.

desc.zh: 用 GOSUB 跳到标签、RETURN 返回的一段代码。GDL 没有函数返回值，结果靠共享变量传递。
desc.en: A block reached with GOSUB and left with RETURN. GDL has no return values — results travel through shared variables.

desc.zh: Archicad 运行脚本时提供的只读变量，如层高、比例、视图类型。名字拼错不报错，只会得到 0。
desc.en: Read-only variables supplied by Archicad at runtime, such as storey height, scale and view type. A misspelt name raises no error — it just yields 0.

desc.zh: 以函数形式读取元素自身信息的命令，如 `REQUEST ("ASSOC_DIMENSION", ...)`。与全局变量的区别是：它查的是「我属于谁、我被怎么放」。
desc.en: Function-style command that reads information about the element itself, e.g. `REQUEST ("ASSOC_DIMENSION", ...)`. Unlike globals, it answers "what am I attached to and how am I placed".

desc.zh: GDL 绘图用的坐标系，原点在插入点、Z 轴朝上。所有命令都在当前局部坐标里生效。
desc.en: The coordinate system GDL draws in: origin at the insertion point, Z axis up. Every command acts in the current local frame.

desc.zh: GDL 用后进先出的堆栈保存坐标系：ADD/ROT/MUL 压栈，DEL 退栈。忘记 DEL 是最常见的位置错乱原因。
desc.en: GDL keeps coordinate frames on a last-in-first-out stack: ADD/ROT/MUL push, DEL pops. Forgetting DEL is the most common cause of misplaced geometry.

desc.zh: 当前局部坐标系的 (0,0,0)。对象的插入点、平面图定位和热区都围绕它定义。
desc.en: The (0,0,0) of the current local frame. The insertion point, plan placement and hotspots are all defined around it.

desc.zh: 对象上的可拖拽控制点（HOTSPOT2），用户拖动即可改尺寸。热区只是交互手柄，不参与显示。
desc.en: Draggable control points on an object (HOTSPOT2) that let users change dimensions. Hotspots are interaction handles only — they are not drawn.

desc.zh: GDL 生成的每一个三维形体都叫 body。大量小 body 会拖慢显示，能用 PRISM 一次画完就不要堆 BLOCK。
desc.en: Each 3D shape GDL creates is a body. Many small bodies slow the model down — prefer one PRISM over dozens of BLOCKs.

desc.zh: 把一个平面轮廓向上挤出成柱体，可带下表面与顶面。墙、板、柱、家具主体基本都用它。
desc.en: Extrudes a 2D contour into a solid, optionally with bottom and top surfaces. Walls, slabs, columns and most furniture bodies are built with it.

desc.zh: 沿路径扫掠截面（SWEEP）或让截面绕轴旋转（REVOLVE）。管件、弯头、圆形扶手都靠这类命令。
desc.en: Sweeping a profile along a path (SWEEP) or revolving it around an axis (REVOLVE). Pipes, elbows and round handrails are made this way.

desc.zh: 先 GROUP 收集实体，再用 SUBGROUP / ADDGROUP / ISECTGROUP 求差、并、交。GDL 没有直接的布尔命令，靠这套机制实现。
desc.en: Collect bodies with GROUP, then subtract, union or intersect via SUBGROUP / ADDGROUP / ISECTGROUP. GDL has no direct boolean command — this is how it is done.

desc.zh: 门窗对象在墙上开出的洞口（WALLHOLE / WALLHOLE2）。洞口由 2D 轮廓定义，深度取自宿主墙。
desc.en: The opening a door or window cuts into its host wall (WALLHOLE / WALLHOLE2). Its profile is 2D; the depth comes from the wall.

desc.zh: 对象在设置对话框里暴露给用户的输入项，有名称、类型、默认值和取值范围。脚本里直接当变量用。
desc.en: An input exposed in the object's settings dialog, with a name, type, default and range. In scripts it is used like a variable.

desc.zh: 图库部件编辑器里定义全部参数的地方（名称、类型、默认值、界面分组）。它是参数脚本与界面脚本的数据基础。
desc.en: Where all parameters are defined in the Library Part Editor — name, type, default, UI group. It is the data foundation for the parameter and UI scripts.

desc.zh: 参数脚本里用 VALUES 给字符串参数填下拉选项。不填，用户在对话框里就只能手打。
desc.en: The VALUES command in the parameter script fills the dropdown of a string parameter. Without it users must type the value by hand.

desc.zh: 参数脚本里的 LOCK 让某个参数变灰不可改，常用于「自动计算」的派生尺寸。
desc.en: LOCK in the parameter script greys out a parameter, typically a derived dimension computed from others.

desc.zh: 不显示在对话框里、但仍参与计算的参数，用 HIDEPARAMETER 控制。适合存内部状态。
desc.en: A parameter excluded from the dialog but still used in calculations, controlled with HIDEPARAMETER. Good for internal state.

desc.zh: 项目级资源的总称，包括材质、填充、笔、线型、表面。GDL 里用索引号引用，不写名称。
desc.en: The umbrella term for project-level resources: materials, fills, pens, line types and surfaces. GDL references them by index, never by name.

desc.zh: 决定 3D 表面颜色与渲染外观的属性，用 MATERIAL 索引指定。索引在各项目里可能不同，跨项目要核对。
desc.en: The attribute controlling 3D surface colour and rendering, referenced by MATERIAL index. Indices can differ between projects — verify when reusing.

desc.zh: 比材质更高一层：带厚度、传热、构造分类，用于墙体与复合结构。它和 MATERIAL 不是同一个东西。
desc.en: One level above materials: carries thickness, thermal data and construction classification for walls and composites. Not the same thing as MATERIAL.

desc.zh: 2D 图案，剖面线与平面填充都用它。GDL 里用 FILL 命令加索引号指定。
desc.en: A 2D pattern used for section and plan hatching, applied in GDL with the FILL command plus an index.

desc.zh: 2D 线与填充的颜色索引，对应项目里的画笔集。打印和屏幕显示都可能与索引不同。
desc.en: Colour index for 2D lines and fills, mapped through the project's pen set. Screen and print output can differ.

desc.zh: 虚线与点划线的样式索引，2D 命令的参数之一。缩放比例会影响显示密度。
desc.en: Index of a dashed or dash-dot style, one of the 2D command arguments. Display density depends on scale.

desc.zh: Graphisoft 官方命令行工具：把 .gsm 拆成可读的 XML + 脚本，或反向打包。批量改写、版本迁移、代码审查都靠它。
desc.en: Graphisoft's official CLI: unpacks a .gsm into readable XML and scripts, or packs it back. Used for batch edits, migration and code review.

desc.zh: 把旧版本图库部件升级到当前 Archicad 版本的过程，主要处理废弃命令与参数类型变化。升级后务必回归测试。
desc.en: Upgrading older library parts to the current Archicad version, mainly handling deprecated commands and parameter type changes. Always regression-test afterwards.

desc.zh: 把整个图库文件夹打包成单个 .lcf 文件，便于分发与版本锁定。加载顺序会影响同名部件的优先级。
desc.en: A whole library folder packed into a single .lcf for distribution and version pinning. Load order decides which duplicate part wins.

desc.zh: Archicad 内置的 GDL 编辑环境，可编辑各脚本页、参数列表和预览图，并直接保存为 .gsm。
desc.en: Archicad's built-in GDL editor for script pages, the parameter list and preview images, saving directly to .gsm.
